items.a: DoreHealth (دوره) is a women's health platform for cycle tracking, symptoms, pregnancy, education, community, and specialist care — with privacy at the center.
Privacy is core to the product. Health data is protected with ownership checks, and admin health views are aggregate-only — no raw cycle logs or symptoms.
Primary UX is Persian. English, Chinese, and Malay are also supported, with Jalali calendar support.
Week-by-week tracking, checklists, kick counter, growth charts, hospital bag, newborn layette, and birth prep tools.
Yes. Verified women's health specialists offer online and in-person consultations with booking, fees, and available slots.
A freemium model with FREE, PREMIUM_TRIAL, and PREMIUM tiers (month / year) unlocks advanced features as you grow with the app.
Android (Capacitor), Progressive Web App, and the web experience at dorehealth.ir.
Yes. Jalali calendar support is available for users who need it.
